migration.description: Retire live downstream and upstream WebSocket proxy capability while retaining legacy settings columns and historical WebSocket invocation records.
migration.release_unit_description: Removal of the unused OpenAI-compatible WebSocket proxy transport and its live configuration surfaces.

durable_state.description: Legacy WebSocket settings and initialization marker in proxy_model_settings, the WebSocket unsupported system tag and its account associations, and historical invocation/archive rows with transport=websocket.
durable_state.storage_implementation: SQLite proxy_model_settings, pool_oauth_login_sessions tag JSON, pool_upstream_account_tags and tag associations, codex_invocations, invocation archives, and existing transport read models.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Supported pre-retirement 0.2.x database schemas containing the WebSocket settings, initialization marker, optional unsupported_transport:websocket system tag, and historical invocation transport values.

dml_changes.description: In one idempotent transaction, force the two legacy WebSocket settings to false, mark websocket_settings_migrated complete, remove only exact integer IDs for unsupported_transport:websocket from valid OAuth session tag JSON while preserving other values, delete associations for the exact system tag, delete that tag row, and record schema_refresh_migrations identity retire_openai_websocket_proxy_v1.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: No historical invocation, archive, usage, network-stat, or unrelated-tag backfill or transformation. Existing transport=websocket rows remain readable and are presented as historical.

progress_signals: The named schema_refresh_migrations identity is present after the transaction commits.
Sanitized migration telemetry reports settings, tag-association, tag-row, and marker outcomes as counts or boolean state.
Historical transport=websocket rows remain visible through existing read and filter contracts without new writes.
pause_points: Before the single DML transaction begins.
After the transaction commits; no historical backfill is scheduled.

recovery.program_rollback_state_behavior: An earlier binary may open the retained schema, but rollback does not automatically restore WebSocket settings, tag state, or the retired runtime contract.
recovery.faulty_release_recovery: A newer binary re-enters the named migration idempotently and repairs incomplete retirement forward; a stopped transaction leaves no partial DML. Database backup restore is required only for disaster recovery or intentional restoration of the old capability.

required_test_evidence: The candidate reads the retained legacy columns and historical transport values without fabricating new WebSocket capability.
The named migration is recognized idempotently and historical invocation/archive rows remain unchanged.
A stopped or failed migration can be safely re-entered by a forward version.

excluded_compatibility_scenarios: Direct multi-Major skips are outside the declared source compatibility range and are not a claimed migration contract; an explicit intermediate upgrade is required.
